response:
Diagnosis. The archive now shows a clear ranking of mechanisms. The two best signals — moat durability (count of years above an absolute profitability hurdle; alpha 2.6%, t 2.56) and capital lightness (alpha 2.2%, t 2.12, Sharpe 0.42) — share two features: a *graded, non-negative, non-level* profitability moderator and a valuation leg based on cash earnings or debt-inclusive capital rather than book equity. Conversely, three failure patterns are now well documented: book-based valuation legs give negative alpha (HML spanning), the all-differences divergence design gave essentially no cross-sectional slope (fmb 0.67), and one-sided own-history legs give high alpha but weak fmb because the low-score side conflates two bad states. This batch therefore (i) crosses the two winning legs, (ii) re-tests the cost-structure moderator whose fmb was the highest ever recorded here (4.58) but whose alpha was destroyed by a gross-profit-to-price valuation leg, (iii) repairs the own-history design with a signed de-rating measure, and (iv) opens two new dimensions: which *dimension* of the moat matters (margin versus capital productivity) and profitability inflection.

---SIGNAL 1---
NAME: MoatDurability_x_TotalCapitalEbitdaYield
EXPRESSION: MUL(TS_SUM(INDICATOR(RATIO(oiadp, at), 0.1), 5), IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(oibdp, ADD(MUL(prcc_f, csho), ADD(dltt, dlc))), 1)))
HYPOTHESIS: A durable franchise is most mispriced when the whole capital structure, not just the equity, is priced cheaply against operating cash profit; the market discounts levered survivors with proven high returns on capital because it anchors on the debt rather than on the durability of the profit stream.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: This crosses the archive's two strongest components — the durability count moderator (t-alpha 2.56) and the strictly positive total-capital yield that produced the best Sharpe (0.42) — to establish whether the durability effect is valuation-leg specific or additive across cheapness definitions. If both t-alpha and Sharpe exceed their parents, the two dimensions are complementary and this becomes the consolidation target for later generations.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 2---
NAME: OverheadBurden_x_TotalCapitalEbitdaYield
EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_RANK(NEG(RATIO(xsga, SUB(revt, cogs)))), IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(oibdp, ADD(MUL(prcc_f, csho), ADD(dltt, dlc))), 1)))
HYPOTHESIS: Cheapness pays more when little of the production profit is consumed by fixed overhead, because a light cost base means the operating profit priced into the multiple actually reaches capital providers.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The cost-structure moderator produced the strongest cross-sectional slope in the archive (fmb 4.58) yet a negative alpha, and the natural diagnosis is the valuation leg: gross-profit-to-price is a book-like, HML-heavy measure, exactly the channel that generated negative alphas in all three of its appearances. Holding the moderator fixed and swapping in the debt-inclusive cash-profit yield isolates whether the alpha failure was caused by the valuation channel rather than by cost structure, which is the single highest-information repair available.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 3---
NAME: MarginDurability_x_CashEarningsYield
EXPRESSION: MUL(TS_SUM(INDICATOR(RATIO(oiadp, sale), 0.1), 5), IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(ADD(ib, dp), MUL(prcc_f, csho)), 1)))
HYPOTHESIS: Durable pricing power, measured as repeatedly sustaining a double-digit operating margin, is the moat dimension that protects a cheap stock, because margins persist through demand cycles whereas returns on assets can be inflated by a shrinking or written-down asset base.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: This holds the valuation leg exactly equal to the archive's best signal and changes only the economic dimension of the durability hurdle from capital productivity to margin persistence, so the comparison directly identifies which kind of franchise evidence the market misprices. It also guards against a mechanical artifact in the winner: an asset-based hurdle can be cleared by asset write-downs, whereas a sales-based hurdle cannot.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 4---
NAME: MoatDurability_x_SignedYieldDeRating
EXPRESSION: MUL(TS_SUM(INDICATOR(RATIO(oiadp, at), 0.1), 5), IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(SUB(RATIO(ADD(ib, dp), MUL(prcc_f, csho)), MA(RATIO(ADD(ib, dp), MUL(prcc_f, csho)), 5)), 1)))
HYPOTHESIS: What matters is not a firm's permanent multiple but its displacement from its own normal multiple: a franchise with proven durable returns trading at a cash yield well above its own five-year average has been de-rated without fundamental cause, and the de-rating reverses.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The own-history family delivered the archive's largest alpha (2.5%) but a weak slope (fmb 1.86) precisely because a bounded TS_RANK leg makes the low-score side an ambiguous mixture; replacing it with a signed deviation from the firm's own five-year mean yield restores a genuinely two-sided spread where the short leg is unambiguously "re-rated above its own norm." Because the valuation state is firm-demeaned, it carries little HML loading, which is why this design produced high alpha in the first place.
INTERACTION_TYPE: novel

---SIGNAL 5---
NAME: AssetLightness_x_NormalizedEarningsYield
EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_RANK(NEG(RATIO(dp, at))), IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(MA(oiadp, 5), MUL(prcc_f, csho)), 1)))
HYPOTHESIS: Pricing a firm against its five-year average operating profit removes cyclical distortion from the cheapness measure, and such normalized cheapness is real value only for asset-light firms whose averaged profit is not an accounting illusion awaiting reinvestment.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: A cycle-averaged earnings denominator is a valuation construction untested in this archive and is economically distinct from spot yields: it identifies firms cheap relative to mid-cycle earning power rather than firms cheap because this year happened to be good. Pairing it with capital lightness, the moderator with the archive's best Sharpe, tests whether normalization adds information beyond the spot yields used so far while keeping coverage high.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 6---
NAME: ProfitInflection_x_CashEarningsYield
EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_RANK(ACCEL(RATIO(oiadp, at))), IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(ADD(ib, dp), MUL(prcc_f, csho)), 1)))
HYPOTHESIS: Cheap stocks re-rate at the inflection point, not at the trend reversal: when the rate of deterioration in operating returns stops worsening, the fundamental news that justified the low multiple has been exhausted, and the market is slow to recognize this second-derivative turn.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Acceleration is a temporal concept the archive has not tested — level, trend, volatility and durability all measure the state or its first derivative, whereas the inflection idea targets the moment the state stops deteriorating, which arrives earlier than a trend signal and should be less priced. The construction keeps the sign discipline that has worked throughout: a bounded non-negative rank weight on the proven cash-earnings-yield valuation leg, with only two lags required so coverage stays near the 0.13 level of the strongest signals.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---CRITIQUE MoatDurability_x_TotalCapitalEbitdaYield---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: A clean factorial cross of the archive's two best-performing legs that is not a duplicate of any prior expression, but it is a mechanical leg-swap with no new economic content, so its main value is diagnostic (is durability leg-specific or additive) rather than genuinely novel.

---CRITIQUE OverheadBurden_x_TotalCapitalEbitdaYield---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: Beyond being another cosmetic valuation-leg swap, the moderator NEG(xsga/(revt-cogs)) is numerically unstable and sign-flipping whenever gross profit is small or negative — exactly the distressed firms that drive the value-trap effect — so the "isolate the valuation channel" diagnosis is confounded by a badly constructed conditioner.

---CRITIQUE MarginDurability_x_CashEarningsYield---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: The switch from an asset-based to a margin-based durability hurdle is an economically meaningful distinction and guards against write-down artifacts, but the absolute 10% margin threshold is not industry-adjusted (unlike the IND_RANK legs elsewhere), so the count risks proxying for industry membership rather than franchise durability.

---CRITIQUE MoatDurability_x_SignedYieldDeRating---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 4
RATIONALE: Replacing the bounded TS_RANK with a signed deviation from the firm's own five-year mean yield is a substantive repair that restores a genuinely two-sided short leg and is well-matched to the stated alpha-vs-slope diagnosis; the residual weakness is that unscaled yield deviations are mechanically larger for high-yield firms, so the leg partly reintroduces the cross-sectional value level it claims to demean away.

---CRITIQUE AssetLightness_x_NormalizedEarningsYield---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 4
RATIONALE: A cycle-averaged (Graham-Dodd style) earnings denominator is a genuinely new valuation construction in this archive and economically distinct from the spot yields tested so far, though the claim that coverage "stays high" is optimistic given five required annual lags, and averaged dollar earnings will tilt against fast-growing firms in a way that may masquerade as value.

---CRITIQUE ProfitInflection_x_CashEarningsYield---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: Acceleration is a temporal dimension the archive has not touched and the expression's direction matches the stated inflection hypothesis, but a second difference of annual ROA is very noisy and closely related to published earnings-acceleration results, so the incremental information over the already-tested TREND moderator may be small.

---SIGNAL 1---
NAME: IntangibleCapitalIntensity_x_TotalCapitalEbitdaYield
EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(xsga, 5), at)), IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(oibdp, ADD(MUL(prcc_f, csho), ADD(dltt, dlc))), 1)))
HYPOTHESIS: Selling and administrative spending is largely investment in brand, distribution and know-how that accounting expenses immediately, so firms with a large accumulated intangible outlay have systematically understated operating profit and capital; when such a firm already looks cheap on measured operating profit, its true economic yield is higher still and the market under-reacts to the hidden capital.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The instability is repaired at the source: the conditioner is now a cumulative five-year outlay scaled by total assets, a strictly non-negative quantity with a denominator that cannot approach zero or flip sign, so distressed firms with collapsed gross profit no longer contaminate the weight. The economic channel is also new to the archive — accounting mismeasurement of expensed intangible investment, rather than cost rigidity, durability, solvency, accruals or capital intensity — and it interacts specifically with a pre-depreciation profit yield that is depressed exactly for these firms, which is why neither leg alone captures the effect.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional
